frames.text:
Data from the World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Bank's World Development Indicators (WDI) provides an overview of health spending in Kenya through 2023:

* **Per Capita Spending**: According to the World Development Indicators, health expenditure per capita in Kenya was **274 international dollars** in 2023, up from **142 international dollars** in 2010.
* **Share of GDP**: According to the World Health Organization, current health expenditure accounted for **4.35%** of Kenya's gross domestic product (GDP) in 2023.
* **Government Priority**: Domestic general government health expenditure represented **8.65%** of general government expenditure in 2023.
* **Household Burden**: Out-of-pocket health expenditure made up **24.2%** of current health expenditure in 2023.
* **Largest provider**: Among the 36 providers of health aid to Kenya in 2024, the United States of America gave the most, $412.5 million in gross ODA disbursements, ahead of the Global Fund at $166.1 million (OECD Creditor Reporting System (CRS)).

The closest series to "current health expenditure as share of GDP" is a loose match: Kenya's health expenditure as a share of a reference expenditure aggregate for Current health expenditure and Out-of-pocket health expenditure in 2023 (World Health Organization (WHO)).
